text:
Noor: Two tiny but excellent updates — 1) Sienna just brought home a corgi pup 🐶 (meet & greet imminent). 2) Lina officially hit her 5-year Redwood anniversary today 🎉
Sienna: AH YES hello new pup is named Biscuit 🧺🥐 posting pics in a sec. I may be biased but short legs = maximum zoomies.
Lina: omg Biscuit!! And thanks y'all, five years went fast. Feeling very emotional and caffeinated. ☕️❤️
Julian: congrats Lina!! 5 years of making infra not cry. cake emoji? :cake:
Priya: Biscuit pic pls pls pls. Also—can we do a tiny office celebration Thursday? I can bring cupcakes.
Sienna: photo dump: https://imgur.com/a/fake-biscuit (mock link) — tiny loaf, big ears. Also happy to bring pup to office if folks want a corgi pop-in 🐾
Noor: poll: in-office corgi visit? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :eyes: if maybe, :no_entry_sign: if nope. Also @people-ops-bot can we reserve the kitchen table for cupcakes?
people-ops-bot: @Noor — Kitchen table booked for Thu 3pm. Please follow the snack policy and label any food for allergies. Congrats Lina! :tada:
Lina: Aww thanks! Thu 3pm works. I'll try not to cry during the toast.
Julian: I will absolutely cry. Also bringing party playlist.
Priya: I'll bring gluten-free options. Congrats Lina and welcome Biscuit!
Sienna: Biscuit is small but will accept pats and corporate snacks responsibly. See you Thursday ❤️🐶
Noor: Okay celebration plan: Thu 3pm kitchen, cupcakes + GF treats, corgi cameo if office crowd wants. RSVP by reacting. Congrats again Lina!!! :confetti_ball:
